independent.scope: Independently designed source, preservation and actual native DOMParser tests. No Wikipedia edits or messages.
resolvedFindings: Protected multiline HTML tables and presentation divs were not excluded from duplicate-box removal.
Existing feature/context flags infoboxes, headings, pageRedirect and pageDisambiguation were not fully honored.
A final section owning a retained dynamic infobox was misclassified as empty.
Unclosed quotation tails could lose repeated template examples.
Infobox_v2 with wikitable class was rejected by old generic table-cell guard after valid duplicate removal.
Group-scoped named references and repeated implicit reference occurrences were not fully counted in displayed-reference guard.
Unclosed literal tails could receive an appended hidden References call on every click; genuine opaque tails now preserve collector/source and remain idempotent.
Plain mathematical inequality < q < was misread as an unclosed HTML q tag, masking later references; the bounded invalid-opener guard preserves the formula and recognizes the true reference list.
Moving punctuation before a reference could leave the next word glued to the marker until a second click.
Original and already-moved decimal/time separators around citations need conservative numeric boundaries, including non-ASCII numerals.
A multiline suffix match could cut general-bibliography links when a reference heading occurred earlier in the prefix.
An entity-closed bracket inside a reference-bank title could swallow an appended style parameter, causing one more style insertion on every click.
conservativeExpectationUpdates: Converted the remaining bare Reflist or references tag into the documented canonical Referências call.
Allowed removal of a final heading made genuinely empty after exact duplicate box removal.
Used the implemented documented structuralRepairs flag instead of proposed automaticStructuralRepairs.
Protected URL fixture uses valid percent-encoding rather than literal spaces outside a bare URL.
Stale proof is tested as inability to authorize an exception, recognizing neutral no-plan API semantics.
limits: Actual public MediaWiki render pair is a shortened incident fixture containing the original boxes and both original sources, not a full public render of the entire article.

Native tests execute the real frozen release as CommonJS-exported pure APIs in a controlled local page with actual DOMParser. Root-level native edit UI tests cover button/report/undo behavior separately.
Additional 1000 complex article corpus collection and broad regression remain coordinated by root.
